walkablePolygons are a UNION; obstacles are subtracted. Do not intersect all polygons.
doors point lies on interior threshold; arrival lies inward. A visual glow should be anchored slightly above foot point, no separate stone portal arch.
No links are authored here: parent owns portal topology. Do not create a link on every window or every stair.

Staircases in round rooms are blocked until a separate elevation traversal is authored; only actual room openings listed as doors.
Throne room side arches are partly obscured by banners; medium-confidence doors require visual playtest if used.
Prison union exposes four cell floors connected to central aisle; furniture rectangles still block beds.
Baked room art may occlude actors at front walls: parent renderer should redraw foreground wall pixels or use conservative front bounds.
